title: Gene Embedding Hub: a standardized resource for human gene representations
authors: Tabares D; Bohl M; Boeva V
one_liner_zh: 该文构建人类基因嵌入向量的标准化资源库，虽涉及基因表示和机器学习，但未聚焦染色质三维组织或空间架构建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Gene embeddings are vector representations of gene identity that provide machine-learning models with information from diverse biological sources. However, their use is hindered by a lack of standardization: inconsistent identifiers, formats, and preprocessing conventions. In this work, we present a unified resource of 67 human gene-embedding sets derived from protein, DNA and RNA sequences, biomedical text, bulk expression data, single-cell expression models, functional data, biological networks, knowledge graphs, regulatory genomics and multimodal models, covering up to 20,097 GENCODE-annotated protein-coding genes. The collection includes both published precomputed embeddings and representations generated or extracted from publicly available models and biological data. Each embedding set is organized in a folder containing the embedding matrix, the Ensembl gene identifiers, machine-readable metadata, and processing documentation. We validate the resource by measuring global and local similarity, cross-embedding consensus, and cross-embedding predictability. The collection is designed to allow community-contributed embeddings that meet predefined technical and documentation requirements, enables comparison of gene representations across modalities and provides standardized embeddings for training and downstream applications.
abstract_zh: 基因嵌入是基因身份的向量表示，为机器学习模型提供来自多种生物来源的信息。然而，其使用因缺乏标准化而受阻：标识符、格式和预处理约定不一致。在本工作中，我们提出了一个统一的资源，包含67个人类基因嵌入集，来源于蛋白质、DNA和RNA序列、生物医学文本、批量表达数据、单细胞表达模型、功能数据、生物网络、知识图谱、调控基因组学和多模态模型，覆盖多达20,097个GENCODE注释的蛋白编码基因。该集合包括已发表的预计算嵌入以及从公开可用模型和生物数据中生成或提取的表示。每个嵌入集组织在一个文件夹中，包含嵌入矩阵、Ensembl基因标识符、机器可读元数据和处理文档。我们通过测量全局和局部相似性、跨嵌入共识和跨嵌入可预测性来验证该资源。该集合设计允许社区贡献满足预定技术和文档要求的嵌入，支持跨模态基因表示的比较，并为训练和下游应用提供标准化嵌入。
